title: Audited lint policy: detectors retained, enforcement disabled
summary: This change introduces a compiled enforcement policy (`lints::policy`) that turns off a set of audited writing and skill detectors by default, while keeping their detectors and fixture contracts alive for evaluation. Consumers — the stop hook, `osf lint writing`, `osf lint skill`, and `osf verify` — now merge these `off` levels into the config levels they apply, so a repository's own `osf.toml` can no longer re-enable a disabled rule or disable a retained one. Alongside the policy, the diff tightens several detectors: the script-pin check is rewritten as a literal command-token parser with an explicit coverage statement, the em-dash rule narrows to U+2014, weasel-attribution accepts a labelled HTTP(S) link, commit messages drop `reference-without-link` and exempt generated merge subjects, and the co-author trailer match becomes case-insensitive.
